title: Global well-posedness for a damped two dimensional fluid--beam system
summary: We study the normalized surface system of an irrotational incompressible fluid of infinite depth beneath an elastic Euler--Bernoulli beam with structural damping. For every fixed damping coefficient $γ>0$, we establish global well-posedness for arbitrary initial data in $H^2(\R)\times\bigl(\dot H^{1/2}(\R)\cap\dot H^1(\R)\bigr)$. The main novelty is that the admissible data include finite energy initial potentials for which neither $ψ_0$ nor $u_0=ψ_0+G(η_0)ψ_0$ has an $L^2$ representative.
